id.description: The validator also requires a non-blank, non-whitespace value and unique entry ids within the pack.

files.description: The validator additionally requires each reference to be relative, to exist, and to resolve inside the skill folder; symlinks, junctions, and reparse points are rejected. The referenced skill's SKILL.md must be at most 256 KB.

items.description: A relative path to an existing file inside the skill folder.

rules.description: Optional plain JSON rule table. The validator additionally enforces a 32 KB serialized limit, maximum depth 6, strings up to 2,000 characters, arrays up to 100 items, objects up to 200 properties, and no prototype-related keys.
